preconditions.description: The input consists of exactly two lines.
The integer n on the first line is between 2 and 200,000 inclusive.
The second line contains exactly n integers.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= 10**9 for x in a)
preconditions.description: Every element in the sequence is a positive integer between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output consists of exactly two lines.
The first line of output contains the count of elements in the final sequence.
The second line of output contains the elements of the final sequence separated by spaces.

postconditions.expression: all(final_seq[i] != final_seq[i+1] for i in range(len(final_seq)-1))
postconditions.description: The final sequence contains no two equal consecutive elements.
The final sequence is the result of repeatedly applying the leftmost merge operation until no equal consecutive elements remain.
